items.title: Audit the step contract matrix for complete inputs, outputs, evidence, missing-evidence handling, and verifier ownership
items.context: Review docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md Step Contract Matrix and Evidence Failure Policy for missing responsibilities or ambiguous proof sources.
items.userSees: User sees the heading "Step Contract Matrix" followed by rows for Step 0 through Step 7 and columns for inputs, outputs, required evidence, missing/stale handling, and verifier.

happy.desc: Step Contract Matrix has rows for state intake, PLAN skeleton, reviewer lanes, evidence, preflight, live smoke, delivery, and done_prepare delegation.

edge.desc: Rows distinguish upstream evidence refresh from TEST-to-DONE stale refresh owned by done_prepare.

adversarial.desc: No row allows stale proof to become fresh by direct hash rewrite or main-agent self-signing.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const checks=[{"file":"docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md","must":["0. State intake and phase preflight","1. Story init / PLAN skeleton","2. Verification evidence generation / refresh","3. Validation, transcript, and delivery context preparation","4. Reviewer lane orchestration","5. REVIEW / TEST gate preflight","6. TEST-to-DONE readiness delegation","7. Phase advance handoff"]}]; for (const c of checks) { const text=fs.readFileSync(c.file,"utf8"); for (const s of c.must) { if (!text.includes(s)) { console.error("missing "+c.file+": "+s); process.exit(1); } } }'
verificationEvidence.note: Node assertion checks every Step Contract Matrix row label for the Step 0-7 lifecycle contract.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const checks=[{"file":"docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md","must":["TEST-to-DONE stale refresh remains","owned by `done_prepare`","done_prepare --dryRun","not a second implementation of DONE readiness","treat delivery as a separate `delivery_check_set` artifact path","latest `done_prepare` report bound to the current `headHash`, `materialHash`","review round, validation ref, and delivery-check artifact"]}]; for (const c of checks) { const text=fs.readFileSync(c.file,"utf8"); for (const s of c.must) { if (!text.includes(s)) { console.error("missing "+c.file+": "+s); process.exit(1); } } }'
verificationEvidence.note: Node assertion checks upstream evidence planning, delivery-check ownership, current-snapshot done_prepare import binding, and TEST-to-DONE readiness delegation boundaries.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const checks=[{"file":"docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md","must":["never rewrite hashes directly","never write `delivery-check.json` from the main host","no track may introduce a second material/evidence/transcript freshness","Only after the observed story phase is\nREVIEW may it call `review_run_start`","rerun `done_prepare --dryRun`"]}]; for (const c of checks) { const text=fs.readFileSync(c.file,"utf8"); for (const s of c.must) { if (!text.includes(s)) { console.error("missing "+c.file+": "+s); process.exit(1); } } }'
verificationEvidence.note: Node assertion checks direct hash rewrite ban, main-host delivery self-sign ban, duplicate freshness-source ban, REVIEW phase-before-reviewers rule, and stale done_prepare import rejection.

items.title: Audit the text and image flowcharts for alignment with the step contract and B-fb36 done_prepare boundary
items.context: Confirm both flowcharts show proof-or-stop behavior and delegate TEST-to-DONE readiness to done_prepare instead of duplicating DONE closure logic.
items.userSees: User sees the heading "Flowcharts", a text flowchart block, and the image link "Lattice standard evidence pipeline flow" pointing at the SVG asset.

happy.desc: The text flowchart lists the full state intake through DONE delegation path with explicit stop points.

edge.desc: The image/SVG flowchart visually distinguishes ordinary preflight from TEST-to-DONE done_prepare delegation.

adversarial.desc: Neither flowchart depicts story_pipeline as independently running main merge, stale TEST evidence refresh, validation, or done_closure for DONE readiness.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const checks=[{"file":"docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md","must":["rerun-required evidence --> print rerun command and STOP","safely refreshable stale evidence --> delegate to existing refresh writer, then return to Step 2","missing user-value proof --> run smoke or require metadata-only waiver; if unavailable, STOP","clean commit + enter REVIEW phase","Delivery check missing or blocking?","Target is DONE and story is in TEST?","7 Phase advance handoff"]}]; for (const c of checks) { const text=fs.readFileSync(c.file,"utf8"); for (const s of c.must) { if (!text.includes(s)) { console.error("missing "+c.file+": "+s); process.exit(1); } } }'
verificationEvidence.note: Node assertion checks the text/Mermaid flow branches for rerun stop, refresh loop, missing-proof stop, REVIEW transition, delivery-check branch, DONE-target decision, and Step 7 handoff.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const checks=[{"file":"docs/requirements/decisions/assets/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-flow.svg","must":["Refresh-only stale","RERUN REQUIRED","Validation and user proof pass?","Clean commit + enter REVIEW phase","Only after REVIEW phase; review current snapshot.","FINDING -> DEV","Delivery check missing or blocking?","Run delivery reviewer and stop.","7. Phase advance handoff","6. Delegate to done_prepare","Import bound PASS","done_prepare PASS","BLOCKED"]}]; for (const c of checks) { const text=fs.readFileSync(c.file,"utf8"); for (const s of c.must) { if (!text.includes(s)) { console.error("missing "+c.file+": "+s); process.exit(1); } } }' && xmllint --noout docs/requirements/decisions/assets/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-flow.svg
verificationEvidence.note: Node assertion plus xmllint checks SVG semantic branches, REVIEW handoff, delivery-check branch, bound done_prepare import, Step 7 handoff, and XML validity.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const checks=[{"file":"docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md","must":["Delegate to lattice done_prepare","duplicating `done_closure`, main-sync, evidence-refresh, or version-bump","not a second implementation of DONE readiness","never reinterpret a `done_prepare` blocker as pass","Hand off to Step 7","latest `done_prepare` report bound to the current `headHash`, `materialHash`"]}]; for (const c of checks) { const text=fs.readFileSync(c.file,"utf8"); for (const s of c.must) { if (!text.includes(s)) { console.error("missing "+c.file+": "+s); process.exit(1); } } }'
verificationEvidence.note: Node assertion checks that the flow delegates DONE readiness, preserves done_prepare blockers, requires current-snapshot done_prepare binding, and only then hands off phase advance.

items.title: Audit the implementation split for safe parallel development without duplicate gate truth sources
items.context: Review the parallel tracks and suggested story breakdown for clear ownership, safe dependencies, and no second implementation of lifecycle gates, delivery review, or done_prepare behavior.
items.userSees: User sees Track A through Track G and P1 through P7 explicitly say DONE readiness is delegated to "done_prepare" where applicable.

happy.desc: P1-P7 identify owners, deliverables, dependencies, and parallel-safety notes.

edge.desc: Tracks that touch delivery, evidence refresh, review gates, or DONE readiness name their dependency on existing gates or done_prepare.

adversarial.desc: No track claims permission to replace reviewer lanes, delivery reviewer signatures, Authority receipts, or done_prepare TEST-to-DONE readiness behavior.

Pipeline State Model And Preflight","Track G.
